fact: On 23 August 2024 President Nyusi laid the foundation stone of the Ministry of Interior's integrated information centre under the SIGESP-MINT project, conceived in 2015 with South Korean support, which is to bring digital technology to the handling of citizens' requests to the police in Maputo, Matola and Nampula.
title: MINT vai contar com Sistema de Informação de Gestão de Segurança Pública
